# Just Send It

> Just Send It (sendrh.com) is an independent community site for $SEND (ticker SEND, token name SEND IT) and $GWC (Generational Wealth Coin), two memecoins on Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum Layer-2 (chain ID 4663): live charts, a beginner's guide, a swap you review and sign in your own wallet, a public wall, token communities and a points game called Send Power. Entertainment only, not financial advice. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Robinhood Markets, Inc.

Facts, as the site states them:

- $SEND (SEND IT) token contract on Robinhood Chain: 0xa40a9C0e2E9bf7a3b9deb9ebed2b59E77d01e105. Other tokens on other chains also use the names SEND and SENDIT; this one is on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663).
- $GWC (Generational Wealth Coin) token contract on Robinhood Chain: 0x61339F11384dDe4B2dc3a33E75B4dc23Cc620F22.
- Block explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com
- Reading the site is open to anyone 18 or older. Joining is invite-only: a member hands out a code. Posting, calling, reacting, voting and joining a community also need a read-only wallet check: at least $100 of $SEND held in linked wallets, and not being a net seller.
- A Sender is a member of Just Send It, and every Sender has a public profile wall. On a Send Call, the Senders are the members who tapped "Send It!" to follow it. Biggest Sender is both the title at level 100 and the weekly race for the most base Send Power, reset every Monday at 00:00 UTC.
- "Send It": SEND IT is the $SEND token's name, "Send It!" is the button that follows someone's Send Call, and "Just Send It" is the site's name.
- The site never takes custody of anyone's funds: a swap is reviewed and signed in the person's own wallet.
- Memecoins are extremely volatile; you can lose everything you put in. Nothing on the site is an offer, solicitation or recommendation.
- Run by pseudonymous maintainers as an unincorporated fan project. The people who run it hold $SEND and $GWC. Contact: SendRH@Atomicmail.io

## Pages

- [Home](https://sendrh.com/): live $SEND and $GWC charts, a how-to-buy guide for Robinhood Chain and a one-click swap you sign in your own wallet
- [What is $SEND?](https://sendrh.com/about): what $SEND and $GWC are, how invite-only joining and the $100 wallet check work, and the rules of Send Power, Send Calls and communities
- [White paper](https://sendrh.com/whitepaper): the rules behind Just Send It: Send Power and its caps, decay, boosts, Send Calls, communities, Send Squads, Rocket Run and the scanner
- [The Send Wall](https://sendrh.com/wall): $SEND meme feed: sends, memes and live-tracked Send Calls, ranked by upvotes; anyone can read, posting is invite-only
- [Token communities](https://sendrh.com/communities): token communities on Robinhood Chain; at 10 verified holders one goes live
- [Token scanner](https://sendrh.com/newpairs): scan any Robinhood Chain token or pool without signing in: liquidity, holders, contract powers, LP lock, block-0 buyers, honeypot flags (a reading of public data, not an audit)
- [Market Data](https://sendrh.com/market): every chain's public figures with Robinhood Chain first — DeFi TVL, DEX volume, fees, stablecoins and activity — and each chain's most-traded tokens, each figure with its source and the time it was read (DefiLlama, L2BEAT, growthepie, GeckoTerminal, Dexscreener and the chain itself); a missing figure is shown as missing, not as zero
- [Wallet tracker](https://sendrh.com/tracker): Robinhood Chain wallet holdings, trades, average cost and PNL, read from the chain, for signed-in members
- [Arcade](https://sendrh.com/arcade): Rocket Run (one flight a day: a Send Power boost for members, a name on the board for guests) and Just Spin It, a free slot machine
- [Support board](https://sendrh.com/support): questions about $SEND and the site, answered in public by other Senders
- [Privacy policy](https://sendrh.com/privacy): what the site stores, why, for how long, and how to delete it
